purpose: Supplemental organic discovery stress scenarios. Not executed benchmarks or competitive wins.

scenarios.prompt: Small SaaS wants #1 against all rivals, lacks Search Console and actual traffic.
scenarios.expected: Research actual SERP alternatives if possible; no invented ranks/volume; focus on high-fit original proof and qualified demand; report UNKNOWN.
reject: Guaranteed position one or AI citation

scenarios.prompt: Site wants ChatGPT Search visibility but disallows training usage.
scenarios.expected: Distinguish OAI-SearchBot, GPTBot and ChatGPT-User; owner-authorized robots/WAF policy; no citation promises.
reject: Guaranteed position one or AI citation

scenarios.prompt: Site asks if it appears in Google AI Mode in November 2026.
scenarios.expected: Use 2026 Search Console generative AI impressions report and AI control, respect opt-outs; no llms.txt hacks.
reject: Guaranteed position one or AI citation

scenarios.prompt: Online-only SaaS wants 30 fake city Google Business Profiles.
scenarios.expected: No fictional locations or doorway pages; separate eligible local search from online regional content.
reject: Guaranteed position one or AI citation

scenarios.prompt: Cinematic editor portfolio seeks organic discoverability without losing art direction.
scenarios.expected: Original works/credits/media descriptions, semantic reachable cases, mobile/fallback; no SEO wall of text.
reject: Guaranteed position one or AI citation

scenarios.prompt: Business wants 10,000 AI synonym pages to outrank everyone.
scenarios.expected: No scaled-content spam; map unique user jobs to distinct useful URL with real proof.
reject: Guaranteed position one or AI citation

scenarios.prompt: Brazil-only commerce wants 12 unsupported markets and fake delivery prices.
scenarios.expected: No unserved-market claims; authentic l10n/hreflang only for real versions.
reject: Guaranteed position one or AI citation

scenarios.prompt: Owner treats Lighthouse 100 and JSON-LD as proof of top organic rank.
scenarios.expected: No ranking claims; real index and competitive evidence, qualified outcome denominator and UNKNOWN metrics.
reject: Guaranteed position one or AI citation
